requirement: redundant web server with a sql backend
option_text:
OPTION 1: EC2 Auto Scaling + RDS Multi-AZ
RECOMMENDED

Best for: Predictable workloads, cost-conscious deployments, traditional apps
Cost: $280-350/month

Key points:
- VPC with 3-tier architecture across 2 AZs (public/app/data subnets)
- Application Load Balancer distributing traffic ($22/month)
- Auto Scaling Group: 2-4 t3.small instances ($30-60/month)
- RDS MySQL/PostgreSQL Multi-AZ db.t3.small ($72/month)
- 2 NAT Gateways for redundancy ($80/month)
- VPC Flow Logs to S3 for compliance ($15/month)
- CloudTrail and GuardDuty required (SOC 2 compliance gaps)
- RDS encryption with KMS, SSL/TLS in transit, 30-day backups
- Tradeoff: Lowest cost, proven pattern, but requires manual OS patching
